title: Hub-free gadgets cannot create parity
claim: Relations whose excluded tuples are pairwise non-adjacent (co-independent; on three variables exactly the 34 knots) are closed under hub-free gluing, self-gluing and pinning, and the glued excluded count is |Z_M^0||Z_N^1| + |Z_M^1||Z_N^0|. Hence relations without a parity face of dimension three or more never produce one: among the 34 knots only the parity knots build parity without hubs, even when several non-parity knots are combined, while with hubs not-all-equal and pins define parity. Memory is never created without hubs.
failure_conditions: A hub-free gadget of non-parity knots whose glued relation is a parity relation on three or more variables.
A co-independent pair whose glued excluded count differs from |Z_M^0||Z_N^1| + |Z_M^1||Z_N^0|.
foundation_claim_scope: Finite Boolean relations glued along shared variables; surfaces are read from the gluing pattern, not drawn. No physical space is claimed.
